headline: The smart bomb teaches itself
lede: MISSILE COMMAND's wave-7 threat now explains itself on the board: the fast battery wears an azure trail, outer fireballs shimmer cyan as they pass a smart bomb harmlessly, and the attract screen flies one — all cosmetic, all byte-clean, all with the arcade's counter-knowledge finally visible without the manual.

notes.text: #3698 shipped (c5b0a6a): azure fast trail while smart bombs are live, gs.resist cyan shimmer on every outer-immunity pass (kills never shimmer), scripted smart-bomb attract ad on a dice-free 540-tick grid.
missilecmdcheck 149/0 incl. a dice-spy proving the new paths roll nothing — waves 1..6 stay byte-identical; two new mutants proven red.

Harness lesson: at the ~4 fps catch-up floor a 6-tick missile life can sit inside one batch and never paint — pixel gates must re-fire on an in-page cadence and threshold at the noise floor (0). Measured 0→512 px spread across loaded vs quiet runs of the same seed.
Never touch a tracked file while .mutant-running exists — the guard aborted a mid-walk README edit exactly as #2049 intends.
